sloka: तस्मिञ्जाते तु तत्काले सज्वालकवलाः शिवाः ।क्रव्यादाश्चापसव्यानि मण्डलानि प्रचक्रमुः ।। ७.९.२९ ॥
transliteration: tasmiñjāte tu tatkāle sajvālakavalāḥ śivāḥ ।kravyādāścāpasavyāni maṇḍalāni pracakramuḥ ।। 7.9.29 ॥

translations.english: At the very moment of his birth, jackals with flaming mouths and other carnivorous animals moved in inauspicious anti-clockwise circles.
